name: Green Street Grocers
shortDescription: Family-run fruit, veg and general grocery shop. Fresh produce delivered daily.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free entrance. Staff are very helpful and will read labels on request.

name: Tesco Express
shortDescription: Convenience supermarket. Good range of ready meals, dairy, and household basics.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free. Automatic doors. Accessible checkout available.

name: The Corner Café
shortDescription: Cosy independent café serving hot drinks, toasties and cakes. Student-friendly prices.
accessibilityNotes: One small step at entrance. Staff are willing to assist.

name: Campus Health Centre
shortDescription: University GP and nurse service. Register as a student patient when you arrive.
accessibilityNotes: Fully step-free. Hearing loop available at reception.

name: Boots Pharmacy
shortDescription: Large pharmacy stocking prescriptions, vitamins, toiletries and over-the-counter medicines.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free. Staff can advise on accessible packaging. Large-print labels available on request.

name: Wash & Go Launderette
shortDescription: Coin- and card-operated washing machines and tumble dryers. Open 7am–10pm daily.
accessibilityNotes: Wide aisles. Controls have tactile buttons. Staff on site until 6pm.

name: Hackney Council Recycling Point
shortDescription: Street-level recycling banks for glass, clothing, small electricals and batteries.
accessibilityNotes: Pavement-level access. Slots are at reachable height. No staff on site.

name: Spice Route Kitchen
shortDescription: Independent South Asian street-food café. Halal options. Popular with students.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free entrance. Helpful staff. Menu available in large print on request.

name: Student Union Shop
shortDescription: On-campus shop selling stationery, snacks, phone chargers and university merchandise.
accessibilityNotes: Fully step-free inside the Student Union building. Accessible entrance on the east side.

name: Rainbow Deli
shortDescription: Independent deli selling international foods, fresh bread, cheeses and a good range of vegan products.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free. Narrow aisles in parts; staff will assist.

name: City Pharmacy
shortDescription: Independent pharmacist. Free prescription delivery to halls. Knowledgeable, friendly staff.
accessibilityNotes: One step at entrance. Staff are happy to come outside to assist.

name: Campus Library
shortDescription: Main university library. Quiet study spaces, PC access, and a disability support desk.
accessibilityNotes: Fully step-free. Screen readers and magnification software on all PCs. Disability support desk on ground floor.

name: Green Bins Café & Swap Shop
shortDescription: Community-run swap shop and café. Bring items you no longer need; take what you can use. Free coffee with any donation.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free. Volunteers available to assist. Quiet sessions on Tuesday mornings.

name: Starbucks
shortDescription: Chain coffee shop. Reliable Wi-Fi, wide range of hot and cold drinks.
accessibilityNotes: Step-free. Staff trained in accessibility support.

name: Campus Disability & Inclusion Office
shortDescription: University support service for students with disabilities. Apply for Disabled Students Allowance here.
accessibilityNotes: Ground floor, step-free. Hearing loop. Private meeting rooms available.
